1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4 4.Ng5.strategy: Hits the pawn on e4 at once and offers a gambit: if Black holds the pawn with a developing move, White has to prove that the lead in development is worth it. Playable, but the knight on g5 is easily challenged and the pawn is real.
1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4 4.Ng5.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Ulysses Gambit
